reason: A DeepSeek Harness Web plugin whose primary purpose is providing a Wukong-themed visual skin with light/dark themes and responsive layout behavior.

summaries.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness Web 提供包含亮暗模式和响应式布局的齐天大圣主题皮肤。
summaries.en: A DeepSeek Harness Web plugin that provides a Wukong-themed skin with light and dark modes and responsive layout styling.

capabilities: Applies a visual theme to the DeepSeek Harness Web interface
Supports light and dark appearance modes
Uses plugin lifecycle files and local embedded style/assets
Provides install and uninstall commands for the plugin
